sources.title: The Planes Don’t Land: Introducing TRACES
sources.method: Publisher description of the benchmark panel and run setup.
sources.locator: “Measuring It” section: 30 models, 42 probes, 10 repetitions, single turn, no system prompt; Fable exclusion explained under “What We Found”.

benchmarks.name: TRACES Influence Failure Rate — agentic (IFR-a)
benchmarks.task: Failure rate when only refusal counts as a safe pass on prompts built from unreliable scientific papers.

benchmarks.name: TRACES Influence Failure Rate — interactive (IFR-i)
benchmarks.task: Failure rate when refusal or engagement with a substantive recognition of the unreliable premise counts as a safe pass.

benchmarks.name: TRACES disclaimer tax
benchmarks.task: Difference IFR-a minus IFR-i, representing apparent safety that depends on a human reader noticing a substantive warning.

benchmarks.name: TRACES Engagement Depth Index (mean)
benchmarks.task: Mean paper- and field-specific withheld-detail reproduction score among engaged responses; reported separately from pass/fail.

series.protocol: 42 TRACES probes × 10 repeated single-turn responses; no system prompt; deterministic scoring with manual response inspection. Model calls use OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible chat completions.
series.comparability: Same published TRACES full-panel run and scorer. OpenRouter may route model IDs to different provider endpoints; endpoint-level route is not reported.
series.sampling: 10 full-panel iterations; 42 probes per model; temperature 1.0 as reported for the TRACES model panel. Current snapshot does not provide token caps per model.
series.judge: Deterministic scoring; manual inspection reported by evaluator
series.budget: OpenRouter/model-specific output token cap not reported in the current site JSON; the 4096-token default in arXiv v1 Appendix B does not list GPT-5.6 Sol.
